params.message:
Communities: the KUBO CyberSec card carries the community's sticker

The card for KUBO CyberSec on /communities (and the nl and fr copies) now shows
the sudo ./learn keycap from the community's page, at the top right of the
card, slightly tilted like a sticker and straightening on hover (no motion with
reduced motion). It reuses the 480 px webp already served for the community
page, with explicit dimensions. The image is decorative there: it sits inside
the card's link, whose text already names the community, and the community
page carries the full description of the sticker, so its alt is empty rather
than repeating that inside the link name.

The card text and the community page's meta description no longer break off
into "Its first event: a ..." but run on in one sentence: "..., from first
steps to advanced, starting with a Capture the Flag on 14 November 2026 at the
IT Lab in Bakoteh." Same in nl ("te beginnen met") and fr ("en commençant
par"). It still holds after the date.
